title: Anthropic sets up a Public Benefit Fund
body: Anthropic set up a Public Benefit Fund: 5% of its shares now, 2% more for every 50% rise in valuation above baseline, roughly 20% in all. The note says none of the Fund's equity goes to lobbying.
